findings.original: A disposed lease reacquired fixed/top/left preparation during a custom-element style callback.

findings.original: Disposal during size-variable setProperty left anchor-width behind because its claim was recorded after the observable write.
findings.disposition: Resolved by browser normalization and claim publication before the setter, followed by identity and value checks.
findings.regression: retires a size publication when its own custom-element style callback disposes the lease

findings.original: A previous owner already finished one solve and retired its strategy pin. Its second pending solve later published left=99px over a successor result at20px because only pin ownership was checked.
findings.disposition: Resolved by including the current projected-size claim identity in isCurrent() before middleware and final coordinate publication. The old pending callback can no longer publish after another lease acquires those fields.
findings.regression: a previously solved owner cannot publish a pending result after a successor owns the size projection
